_comment: Target keywords for streamlinedai.tech. Rewritten 18 Nov 2026 (PM brief seo-trade-pages-1118) for a worldwide English-speaking audience: owners of trade and service businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Ireland. Top-level keys that do not start with _ are clusters of lowercase phrases matched exactly against GSC query strings by checks/gsc-snapshot.mjs. The pattern is trade + what the buyer wants, with NO country on the end: do not add 'ireland', 'galway' or any country to a target phrase unless a country page exists, and none does. EVERY PHRASE HERE IS A CANDIDATE: none has a measured volume and no SERP research was done for the trade clusters. Search Console decides, not guesses. Several are probably held by large software vendors, so zero impressions is a content gap, not an alarm, and no ranking may be claimed. A page may only be proposed for a trade in config/trades-built.json. All clusters from the old Irish-only, AI Employees, set-up-AI, AI consulting, contractors, installers, Australia and AI training positioning were removed on purpose and must not come back. Edit only through the Atlas & Website Product Manager and the Build Manager.
